proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate (or stamped engine code) and the surrounding area.
Send a short running video with audio (idle + light rev) to confirm no knock.
Send an OBD/diagnostic scan screenshot showing fault codes (and readiness if available).
Send photos of all included components (ECU/ECM, alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, hoses) laid out, and confirm what’s included/excluded.
Send import/origin proof (Belgium/tokunbo documents) or at least the receipt/shipping page.
Send the guarantee document/terms in a photo.
